Name: Less Haggard Shane - 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Edit
Author: IBSammy
Description:
talkohlooeys' has given permission for people to make edits to their work, and so I did. This is my sixth one, Less Haggard Shane.

[u]Install Instructions:[/u]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿ and its requirements
[*]Unzip my folder from wherever you saved it
[*]Copy contents from this unzipped folder to \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\
[/list]
